title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer for thermal conductivity as 5 x 10^-3 cal/s·cm°C.

title: Use of Fourier Law
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply Fourier's law of heat conduction in their calculations.

title: Solar Radiation Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must accurately calculate the intensity of solar radiation in cal/s·cm².

title: Temperature Difference
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly identify and use the temperature difference (T1 - T0) in their calculations.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Reflection Consideration
description: Optional Criteria: The student should mention the effect of reflection on the thermal conductivity estimate.

title: Common Calculation Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect unit conversions.
